title: Staff mail: staging's news reaches the person who pressed, and mail to a staff login goes to its work email
why: The "Staging is refreshed" email (2026-11-26) went to <staff id>@staff.traversence.invalid: the hidden address of the staff login that pressed Start staging over. That address takes no mail, so nobody heard. Approved by the session manager, relaying Jason: do the staging emails through Notify by staff id, and route every other Mailer::send that uses a staff login's hidden address the same way. Now (a) staging's two notices (a copy finished or stopped, a publish's result) reach a staff login through Notify by its staff id (new kind staging.done: Pulse and the work email), and a member who pressed by their own email; (b) Mailer::send itself resolves an address at @staff.traversence.invalid to that login's active staff_accounts.email, as Notify::addressOf does. That covers StagingApi's send-me, Releases, AiAssist, Vault, GuideAudits, Takedowns, Services, Claims and admin/Workflow.php's "email the owner" step, all of which could mail a hidden address. An ended login, one with no work email, or any other .invalid address is refused with why and logged in comms_route as 'refused' ("not sent: no deliverable address"). Releases' review email (~840) and DailyReport::owners() already resolve these addresses; admin/tools.php's gallery notice mails only members and business teams. No table, no outside call beyond the mail the site already sends.
